sql_templates.concise_table:
SELECT 
            s.symbol, 
            s.signal, 
            s.price_at_issue, 
            s.price_at_resolution, 
            s.return_pct, 
            s.hit_target, 
            s.hit_stop,
            ss.stage, 
            ss.technical_score 
        FROM 
            signals.signal_log s
        LEFT JOIN 
            scores.stage_snapshots ss ON s.symbol = ss.symbol 
            AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
        WHERE 
            s.date_resolved >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
        ORDER BY 
            s.date_resolved DESC
        LIMIT 50;
